title: Israeli troops force families from homes amid settler terror campaign in West Bank
excerpt: Former PM of Israel calls events ‘concerted and meticulous attempt at ethnic cleansing’ against Palestinians
content_html:
Israeli troops have forced two Palestinian families to leave their besieged West Bank homes, the day after a top Israeli commander personally promised he would end a violent settler campaign to drive them out.

Israeli soldiers also took over eight other homes in Qusra early on Thursday, telling the village’s mayor, Abdul Azim Wadi, that the buildings were needed for a days-long operation to remove the settlers. They later relinquished six. Settlers still roam the village.

The Palestinians’ ordeal began on Sunday when Israeli settlers and soldiers set up a tent blocking the entrance to three homes on the edge of the village. They severed water and electricity supplies and prevented an ambulance from reaching a sick toddler.

Amid mounting international pressure over the siege, Maj Gen Avi Bluth, who commands all Israeli troops in the occupied West Bank, visited Qusra on Wednesday to meet the trapped Palestinians and committed to “evacuate” the settlers from the village.

Bluth’s troops later removed the tent but left the militants, their bedding and other equipment. Soldiers retreated after a failed attempt to drive out the Israeli settler group with riot control techniques. The siege continued into a fifth day on Thursday, with the impact on the village only expanding after Bluth’s visit.

“The army arrived at around 10am and asked us to evacuate the houses because of a military operation in the area that would last for three days. We refused to leave,” said Qusai Ridi, one of the besieged Palestinians. “The army then moved us all into one house.”

He was allowed to return home in the afternoon, where he found Israeli soldiers had damaged a security camera system and stolen some equipment. They are still occupying the home of his neighbour Yousef Hassan, who is staying with Ridi.

Settlers are still patrolling outside in the area where 28-year-old Amir Moatasem Odeh was killed by a settler in March. Another attacker stabbed his father. No one has been arrested over the murder and assault.

“I am afraid and do not trust that the army will actually evacuate the settlers. But I sincerely hope they do,” Ridi said.

His brother is an American citizen, and the US ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, who is generally supportive of Israel’s settlement project, described the siege as a “horrific act of terror” carried out by Israeli terrorists.

On Thursday afternoon, Israeli soldiers left six homes they had taken over in the morning. The returning Palestinian families reported damage including a Qur’an with pages torn out and destroyed decorations.

Israel’s former prime minister Ehud Olmert said the siege was a “concerted and meticulous attempt at ethnic cleansing”, which left him disgusted and ashamed.

“These are crimes against humanity which are actively supported by the Israeli government and are assisted by the indifference and total lack of action by the IDF and the Israeli police. It’s unforgettable and unforgivable.”

The same terror tactics were used to force another Palestinian family out of their home in the neighbouring village of Jalud in July. Soldiers and settlers were filmed playing with a football together on the terrace of that house on Thursday.

An Israeli military spokesperson said soldiers had been ordered not to displace Palestinian residents of Qusra and would not operate inside the besieged homes.

“The soldiers were instructed that the Qusra residents will remain in their homes,” the military said in a statement. The spokesperson declined to comment on why those orders were being violated.

The chief of the general staff of the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), Eyal Zamir, has ordered a battalion of infantry reservists back from leave to reinforce troops in the West Bank. Domestic critics said the army’s failures in Qusra were more the result of a lack of will than shortage of forces.

“Yesterday’s events in Qusra illustrate the impotence of the IDF, the police, the GSS [Shin Bet] and other security organizations in the face of a group of bullies,” the commentator Avi Ashkenazi wrote in the Israeli newspaper Ma’ariv.

“Instead of bringing a police van [and] arresting the criminals … [security forces] have been trying to negotiate with them. They are thugs. They believe themselves to be the lords of the land.”

Israeli militants target Palestinians with near total impunity in the occupied West Bank. Since 2020, Israeli civilians and soldiers have killed more than 1,100 Palestinians there, and there has been only one indictment over those deaths.

Violence is deployed as part of a broader campaign of ethnic cleansing. Israel has forcibly displaced 64 Palestinian communities over the past three years, the rights group B’Tselem said. Fifteen other communities have lost residents, with more than 4,800 people driven from their homes.

Sufian Taha contributed reporting

content_html_zh:
以色列军队迫使两个巴勒斯坦家庭离开被围困的西岸家园，就在第二天，以色列高级指挥官亲自承诺，他将结束暴力定居者运动，将他们赶出。

周四早些时候，以色列士兵还占领了库斯拉的另外八栋房屋，并告诉村长阿卜杜勒·阿齐姆·瓦迪，这些建筑物是用于为期数天的驱逐定居者行动所需要的。 他们后来放弃了六个。 定居者仍然在村庄里漫步。

巴勒斯坦人的苦难从周日开始，当时以色列定居者和士兵搭建了一个帐篷，挡住了村庄边缘三栋房屋的入口。 他们切断了水和电力供应，并阻止救护车到达生病的幼儿。

在国际社会对围困施加的压力越来越大的情况下，指挥被占领约旦河西岸所有以色列军队的阿维·布鲁斯少将周三访问了库斯拉，会见了被困的巴勒斯坦人，并承诺从该村“撤离”定居者。

布鲁斯的部队后来拆除了帐篷，但留下了武装分子、他们的床上用品和其他装备。 士兵们试图用防暴技术驱逐以色列定居者团体，但失败后撤退。 周四，围困持续到第五天，在布鲁斯访问后，对村庄的影响只会扩大。

“上午 10 点左右，军队抵达并要求我们撤离房屋，因为该地区的军事行动将持续三天。 我们拒绝离开，”被围困的巴勒斯坦人之一库赛·里迪 (Qusai Ridi) 说道。 “然后军队把我们都搬到了一所房子里。”

下午他被允许返回家中，在那里他发现以色列士兵损坏了安全摄像系统并偷走了一些设备。 他们仍然占据着他的邻居优素福·哈桑的家，他和里迪住在一起。

定居者仍在该地区外巡逻，28 岁的 Amir Moatasem Odeh 在 3 月份被定居者杀害。 另一名袭击者刺伤了他的父亲。 没有人因谋杀和袭击而被捕。

“我担心也不相信军队真的会撤离定居者。 但我真诚地希望他们这样做，”里迪说。

他的兄弟是美国公民，美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比总体上支持以色列的定居点项目，他将这次围困描述为以色列恐怖分子实施的“可怕的恐怖行为”。

周四下午，以色列士兵离开了他们早上占领的六所房屋。 返回的巴勒斯坦家庭报告了损坏情况，包括一本《古兰经》的页面被撕毁，装饰品被毁。

以色列前总理埃胡德·奥尔默特表示，这次围困是“一次协调一致、一丝不苟的种族清洗企图”，这让他感到厌恶和羞愧。

“这些危害人类罪得到了以色列政府的积极支持，并得到了以色列国防军和以色列警察的冷漠和完全不采取行动的协助。 这是令人难忘且不可原谅的。”

7 月，同样的恐怖策略也被用来迫使另一个巴勒斯坦家庭离开邻近的贾鲁德村的家。 周四，士兵和定居者被拍到在那栋房子的露台上一起踢足球。

以色列军方发言人表示，士兵已接到命令，不得驱赶库斯拉的巴勒斯坦居民，也不得在被围困的房屋内行动。

军方在一份声明中表示：“士兵们接到指示，库斯拉居民将留在家中。” 该发言人拒绝就违反这些命令的原因发表评论。

以色列国防军 (IDF) 总参谋长埃亚勒·扎米尔 (Eyal Zamir) 已下令一个营的步兵预备役人员休假后返回，以增援约旦河西岸的部队。 国内批评人士表示，军队在库斯拉的失败更多是因为缺乏意愿，而不是兵力不足。

评论员阿维·阿什肯纳齐 (Avi Ashkenazi) 在以色列报纸《Ma’ariv》上写道：“昨天在库斯拉发生的事件表明，以色列国防军、警察、GSS [Shin Bet] 和其他安全组织在一群恶霸面前是无能为力的。”

“[安全部队]一直在试图与他们谈判，而不是派出警车[并]逮捕罪犯。 他们是暴徒。 他们相信自己是这片土地的主人。”

以色列武装分子在被占领的约旦河西岸以巴勒斯坦人为目标，几乎完全不受惩罚。 自2020年以来，以色列平民和士兵已经杀害了1100多名巴勒斯坦人，而针对这些死亡事件只有一份起诉书。

暴力是更广泛的种族清洗运动的一部分。 人权组织 B’Tselem 表示，以色列在过去三年中强迫 64 个巴勒斯坦社区流离失所。 另外 15 个社区也失去了居民，超过 4,800 人被迫逃离家园。
